readme: ![Power11](module/banner.png) # Power11 **Bring back the old gem from Android 11.** A KernelSU Next module that replaces the HyperOS / MIUI power menu with the classic AOSP one, and lets you choose exactly what goes in it. ## Features - **AOSP power menu** on HyperOS / MIUI - **Any items, any order**: Recovery, Restart, Bootloader, Power off, SystemUI, Soft reboot, Emergency, Lockdown, Screenshot, Airplane mode, Sound mode, Settings, Bug report. Drag to reorder. - **Grid**: 2 or 3 columns, presets *Essential 2×2* and *All-in 2×3* - **Blur** behind the menu, with adjustable strength - **WebUI** with a live preview; changes apply the next time you open the menu - Survives OTA updates and uninstalls cleanly ## Requirements - KernelSU Next - [Vector](https://github.com/JingMatrix/Vector) or LSPosed, for custom items and order (the AOSP menu itself works without it) ## Install 1. Download the latest zip from [Releases](https://github.com/LuigiColantuono/Power11/releases/latest), then KernelSU Next → Modules → Install from storage, and reboot. 2. Vector → Modules → enable **Power11**, scope **System UI**. 3. Power11 WebUI → *Restart* SystemUI, then pick your items. Updating from *AOSP Power Menu* (v1/v2)? Just install Power11: it replaces the old module and keeps your settings. Later updates show up in KernelSU Next automatically. ## How it works | Part | What it does | |---|---| | `power11.sh` | Disables the `miui.systemui.plugin` service bound to `PLUGIN_GLOBAL_ACTIONS`, so SystemUI falls back to its AOSP `GlobalActionsDialogLite` | | Power11 APK (installed as a regular app) | Vector hook in SystemUI: sets the item list and order, grid columns, and adds the reboot entries. Reads `Settings.Global power11_items` / `power11_columns` on every menu open | | `watcher.sh` | SystemUI may not reboot to recovery/bootloader. The hook creates `power11_` in SystemUI's data dir and this root process (busybox `inotifyd`, no polling) runs it | ## Command line ```sh su -c sh /data/adb/modules/power11/power11.sh help ``` ## Build Requirements: Python 3 with Pillow, a JDK, and the Android SDK (build-tools and one platform) in `ANDROID_HOME`. ```sh python build.py --all ``` ## Preview ## Notes - Lockdown only appears if it is enabled in the lock screen settings. - If the WebUI says *Plugin not found*, this HyperOS build does not expose the power menu as a SystemUI plugin. - Config and logs: `/data/adb/power11/`. ## Credits Made by **Luigi Colantuono**. ## License [MIT](LICENSE)
readmeHTML:
!Power11

Power11

Bring back the old gem from Android 11. A KernelSU Next module that

replaces the HyperOS / MIUI power menu with the classic AOSP one, and lets you

choose exactly what goes in it.

Features

  • **AOSP power menu** on HyperOS / MIUI
  • **Any items, any order**: Recovery, Restart, Bootloader, Power off, SystemUI,

    • Soft reboot, Emergency, Lockdown, Screenshot, Airplane mode, Sound mode,

    Settings, Bug report. Drag to reorder.

  • **Grid**: 2 or 3 columns, presets *Essential 2×2* and *All-in 2×3*
  • **Blur** behind the menu, with adjustable strength
  • **WebUI** with a live preview; changes apply the next time you open the menu
  • Survives OTA updates and uninstalls cleanly

    • Requirements

  • KernelSU Next
  • [Vector](https://github.com/JingMatrix/Vector) or LSPosed, for custom items

    • and order (the AOSP menu itself works without it)

    Install

  • Download the latest zip from [Releases](https://github.com/LuigiColantuono/Power11/releases/latest),

    • then KernelSU Next → Modules → Install from storage, and reboot.

  • Vector → Modules → enable **Power11**, scope **System UI**.
  • Power11 WebUI → *Restart* SystemUI, then pick your items.

    • Updating from *AOSP Power Menu* (v1/v2)? Just install Power11: it replaces the

    old module and keeps your settings. Later updates show up in KernelSU Next

    automatically.

    How it works

    | Part | What it does |

    |---|---|

    | power11.sh | Disables the miui.systemui.plugin service bound to PLUGIN_GLOBAL_ACTIONS, so SystemUI falls back to its AOSP GlobalActionsDialogLite |

    | Power11 APK (installed as a regular app) | Vector hook in SystemUI: sets the item list and order, grid columns, and adds the reboot entries. Reads Settings.Global power11_items / power11_columns on every menu open |

    | watcher.sh | SystemUI may not reboot to recovery/bootloader. The hook creates power11_ in SystemUI's data dir and this root process (busybox inotifyd, no polling) runs it |

    Command line

    su -c sh /data/adb/modules/power11/power11.sh help

    Build

    Requirements: Python 3 with Pillow, a JDK, and the Android SDK (build-tools and

    one platform) in ANDROID_HOME.

    python build.py --all

    Preview

    Notes

  • Lockdown only appears if it is enabled in the lock screen settings.
  • If the WebUI says *Plugin not found*, this HyperOS build does not expose the

    • power menu as a SystemUI plugin.

  • Config and logs: `/data/adb/power11/`.

    • Credits

    Made by Luigi Colantuono.

    License

    MIT
